title: Certified exact identification of the I3322 quantum value
summary: We determine the quantum value of the three-setting, two-outcome Bell functional I3322. The value is the unique intersection \(q_\dagger\) of an analytic A-high stable curve of the exact Jacobi characteristic map with a central reverser curve. A computer-assisted proof isolates this intersection in a rational interval of width \(10^{-55}\), beginning 0.2508753845139765356173366109459512989013219739714764755.
